canonical_title: Relaxed Presentation: Voice and Body Language (SOLER)

one_line_answer.text: Being relaxed communicates that you are comfortable and have good subject knowledge.

cites.quote: Being relaxed communicates the impression that you are comfortable with the session and you have a good background knowledge of the subject.

bangla_explanation: Relaxed থাকলে learners বুঝে আপনি বিষয়টা জানেন আর প্রস্তুত।
কিছুটা anxiety স্বাভাবিক, বরং এটা ভালো perform করতে সাহায্য করে।
Voice: rate, volume, pitch খেয়াল রাখুন।
Body language-এর জন্য SOLER মনে রাখুন; এতে learners স্বস্তি পায় আর অংশ নেয়।

example.en: Before a class, a nervous trainer takes a few deep breaths. In class she stands straight, keeps her arms open and smiles.
example.bn: নার্ভাস trainer ক্লাসের আগে কয়েকবার গভীর শ্বাস নেন, ক্লাসে সোজা দাঁড়ান, হাত খোলা রাখেন।

mnemonic.text: SOLER = Squarely, Open posture, Lean forward, Eye contact, Relax
mnemonic.explain_bn: প্রতিটি অক্ষর একটা body language hint: সোজা, খোলা ভঙ্গি, একটু ঝুঁকে, স্বাভাবিক চোখাচোখি, relax।

list_answer.title: SOLER: body language for a relaxed presentation

items.text: S: Sit, stand or situate squarely (straight).

cites.quote: S Sit, stand or situate squarely (straight).

items.text: O: Open body posture (e.g. try not to cross your arms).

cites.quote: O Open body posture (e.g. try not to cross your arms).

items.text: L: Lean slightly forward to indicate that you are interested.

cites.quote: L Lean slightly forward to indicate that you are interested.

items.text: E: Eye contact should be natural.

cites.quote: E Eye contact should be natural.

items.text: R: Relax to indicate that you are comfortable and ready to receive feedback.

cites.quote: R Relax to indicate that you are comfortable and ready to receive feedback.

items_bn: S — learners-এর দিকে মুখ করে সোজা হয়ে (squarely) বসুন বা দাঁড়ান।
O — খোলা ভঙ্গি (open posture) রাখুন; হাত ভাঁজ করে দাঁড়াবেন না।
L — সামান্য সামনে ঝুঁকুন, এতে বোঝায় আপনি আগ্রহী।
E — eye contact স্বাভাবিক রাখুন, জোর করে নয়।
R — relaxed থাকুন, এতে বোঝায় আপনি স্বস্তিতে আছেন আর feedback নিতে প্রস্তুত।

traps.text: Some level of anxiety is natural; anxiety helps you to perform at your best.

cites.quote: Some level of anxiety is natural. In fact, anxiety helps you to perform at your best.

traps.text: Pitch can convey unintentional emotion, so be careful.

cites.quote: Pitch: Be careful, pitch can convey unintentional emotion.

traps.text: Be cautious about generalisations in body language. Be yourself and practice.

cites.quote: Body language Be cautious about generalisations in this area. Be yourself and practice.

rows.text: Speak at a conversational rate, not too fast or too slow.

cites.quote: Try to speak at a conversational rate - not too fast or too slow.

rows.text: You must be heard clearly. You can alter volume for effect.

cites.quote: You must be able to be heard clearly. You can alter volume for effect.

rows.text: Be careful, pitch can convey unintentional emotion.

cites.quote: Be careful, pitch can convey unintentional emotion.

short.prompt: Which voice cues support a presentation, and how can you manage anxiety?
short.modelAnswer:
Voice cues:
1. Rate: speak at a conversational rate.
2. Volume: be heard clearly.
3. Pitch: be careful; it can convey unintended emotion.
Hints for anxiety: take a few deep breaths; exercise before the session; use relaxation techniques; accept that nerves are OK; practise public speaking.
Body language: SOLER.

keyPoints.text: Rate: speak at a conversational rate, not too fast or too slow.

cites.quote: Rate: Try to speak at a conversational rate - not too fast or too slow.

keyPoints.text: Volume: you must be heard clearly.

cites.quote: Volume: You must be able to be heard clearly.

keyPoints.text: Anxiety hints: take a few deep breaths and exercise before the session.

cites.quote: take time for a few deep breaths
exercise before the session
Some hints to help with anxiety are:

keyPoints.text: Practising public speaking for your session helps you gain confidence.

cites.quote: practising public speaking for your session will help you gain confidence

keyPoints.text: Active listening: attend, encourage feedback, clarify, paraphrase and summarise.

cites.quote: Active listening involves:
attending to learners
encouraging feedback
clarifying and paraphrasing information to check
summarising information

mcq.prompt: In SOLER, what does 'O' stand for?

answerCite.quote: O Open body posture (e.g. try not to cross your arms).

cite.quote: S Sit, stand or situate squarely (straight).
O Open body posture (e.g. try not to cross your arms).

viva.prompt: What do the SOLER hints show your learners?

answer.text: A non-threatening manner, which relaxes learners and invites participation.

cites.quote: By following these hints you will demonstrate a non-threatening manner which will relax learners and invite participation.
